content.text:
I'm figuring out the rule: a lone marker cell fires a ray toward the nearest shape in its cardinal direction, filling cells until it reaches the shape. I'm sketching a first example on a 12x12 grid with a rectangle that has a gap, placing a marker outside so the ray travels downward into the gap.

Then I'm designing two more example pairs the same way—one with a gap on the left side and a marker firing rightward, another with a gap on the bottom and a marker firing upward—each time confirming the ray fills the correct empty cells until it hits the rectangle's border.
